comparison.objective: Both concern robot end effectors, but the candidate adjusts a gripper's opening stop while this record mounts a separate suction tool on a quick-change flange.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate counterholds an adjustment screw while tightening a jam nut; the record aligns a tool plate to flange features while another hand turns or presses a locking-ring lever.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires a retained target angle over repeated articulation; the record requires the selected tool seated and locked on the flange, hanging unsupported with hands withdrawn.
comparison.reason: Shared bimanual holding-while-locking is generic; flange registration and payload latching do not test preserving a screw-defined motion limit against locknut reaction.
